lanes.name: core
lanes.description: VideoToolCore pure gesture logic (Swift Testing) built with plain swiftc; works inside the agent sandbox.

lanes.name: unit
lanes.description: App tests without real libmpv (macOS). Run outside the sandbox (DerivedData in ~/Library). Exit 65 = test failure.
lanes.command: scripts/xcb.sh test -skip-testing:VideoToolTests/MPVIntegrationTests -skip-testing:VideoToolTests/FormatMatrixTests; rc=$?; if [ $rc -eq 65 ]; then exit 1; fi; exit $rc

lanes.name: integration
lanes.description: Tests against real libmpv (MPVIntegrationTests) with the bundled fixture video. Includes FormatMatrixTests (every codec/container in Tests/Fixtures/formats).
lanes.command: scripts/xcb.sh test -only-testing:VideoToolTests/MPVIntegrationTests -only-testing:VideoToolTests/FormatMatrixTests; rc=$?; if [ $rc -eq 65 ]; then exit 1; fi; exit $rc

lanes.name: prototype
lanes.description: mpv Lua gesture prototype unit tests (luajit, fake mp module).
